candidate_extraction.classification_notes: Manchester City discloses matchday, broadcasting, and commercial revenue directly in the annual accounts, with broadcasting split between UEFA and all-other lines that have been combined here. Player-trading profit is disclosed separately and excluded from football revenue.
candidate_extraction.women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the report.
candidate_extraction.non_football_revenue_notes: Other commercial activities may include hospitality, sponsorship, and other club commercial operations classified within ordinary activities.
